meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified Code de commerce and Code monétaire et financier; jurisdiction of the Tribunal de commerce and Cour d'appel)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF) Arts. L.561-1 to L.561-50, L.561-45 to L.561-48 and L.562-1 to L.562-12; Code de commerce Arts. L.123-28, R.123-33 to R.123-38 (RCS registration over the Guichet Unique) and R.123-161; Décret n° 2017-1094 du 12 juin 2017 (UBO declaration modalities); Ordonnance n° 2016-1635 du 1er décembre 2016 (creation of the Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs - RBE); Loi n° 2016-1691 du 9 décembre 2016 (Loi Sapin II); Ordonnance n° 2020-115 du 12 février 2020 (5th AML Directive transposition); CJEU 22 November 2022, joined cases C-37/20 WM and C-601/20 Sovim, restricting general public access to the RBE; AMF Position DOC-2010-10 and ACPR instructional framework on identification of beneficial owners.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (post-CJEU C-37/20 & C-601/20): access to the French register of beneficial owners is limited to (i) AML obliged entities executing statutory KYC, (ii) national authorities (DGFiP, Tracfin, AMF, DGCCRF) and (iii) individuals demonstrating a legitimate interest through a separate judicial authorization; no unconditional public search.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport of each direct or indirect UBO and of the proposed gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the country of residence (e.g., Hong Kong Immigration Department or national police)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for Hague member states) or, for non-member jurisdictions, French consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or certified copy of the birth certificate (acte de naissance) of the proposed gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Civil registry office (bureau de l'état civil) of the country of birth
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille and sworn translation into French by a court-registered translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / certificate of incumbency of any corporate shareholder (if any, e.g., Hong Kong holding company)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction, typically issued through a licensed company secretary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (in Hong Kong, issued by the High Court Apostille Registry)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney granted to the French notary or avocat for signature of the Articles of Association and bank formalities
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the shareholder's jurisdiction with notarial register entry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or French Consulate legalization if the document originates in a non-Apostille state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of address of the proposed gérant (utility bill, bank statement, or official tenancy agreement), dated within 90 days
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, licensed credit institution, or local prefecture / public authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille generally not required; certified sworn translation into French is mandatory

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-registration screening of every identified UBO and the proposed gérant against (i) the French national asset-freeze register (Arrêtés Ministère de l'Économie, DG Trésor), (ii) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, (iii) the UN Security Council Consolidated List, (iv) OFAC SDN list, and (v) FATF public statements; screening repeated every 90 days and within 24 hours of any news of new restrictive measures; simple due diligence (Art. L.561-10 CMF) applies to this Low_Risk_Standard profile, while enhanced vigilance (Art. L.561-10-2 CMF) is triggered if any UBO or the gérant is a PEP; records must be retained for 5 years after closure of the business relationship (Art. L.561-12 CMF).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Data - Official National Enterprise Register (data.inpi.fr) and Infogreffe (infogreffe.fr) for RCS extracts; filing is effected exclusively through the government Guichet Unique at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be expressed in Latin characters; a French-language designation must be added to all commercial documents in accordance with the 'Loi Toubon' (Art. L.121-1 Code de la consommation); non-Latin scripts (Cyrillic, Arabic, Chinese characters) are not accepted for the RCS registration, and any transliteration must be phonetic and consistent with the trademark search carried out at INPI.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque / Bank / Assurance / Insurance (require prior ACPR licence)
France / République / Ministère / Préfecture / Consulat / Ambassade (reserved for state or diplomatic bodies)
Avocat / Notaire / Huissier / Expert-comptable / Commissaire aux comptes (regulated professions)
Google / Apple / Webtoon (third-party trademarks when used in a misleading manner)
SARL / SA / SAS (may appear only as the true legal form indicator)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France operates a first-to-file RCS system: the name is not definitively reserved until the registration application is deposited via the Guichet Unique. If the greffier (court clerk) refuses registration on grounds of confusion, ordre public, or misleading content, the applicant may (i) file a written informal appeal (recours gracieux) with the Greffe within 15 days of the refusal, and (ii) subsequently file an judicial motion (requête) before the President of the Tribunal de commerce within 15 days (Art. L.123-33 and R.123-25 CCom); a parallel trademark opposition may be filed with INPI if a prior registered French or EU trademark conflicts; after acceptance, the mandatory notice of constitution (Avis de constitution) must be published in a legal announcement journal before completion of the RCS registration.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for an SARL engaged in digital webtoon publishing under Art. L.123-11-1 and L.123-11-2 CCom, provided the domiciliation provider holds the prefecture approval (agrément) and maintains a physical address in France. The domiciliation contract may be concluded for a maximum period of ten years (3-year renewable market standard), and the company must display its sign and accept official notifications at the registered office. Fiscal substance requires that the effective place of management be in France: Apple/Google IAP revenues constitute electronically supplied services taxable in France (Art. 259 B CGI) subject to French VAT, and licensing royalties accrue to the French SARL as French-source taxable income (Art. 209 CGI); therefore a purely virtual location is acceptable for this Low_Risk_Standard, licence-free business only if the accounting files, VAT returns, and management decisions are materially held in France.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified annual probability of 5-8% for this industry profile. Unannounced on-site inspections may be carried out by the DGFiP under the right of visit and seizure (Art. L.16 B LPF), by URSSAF for social compliance (Art. L.243-13 CSS), and by the DGCCRF for consumer protection associated with digital subscription products. The absence of statutory licensing and the low-risk classification reduce the baseline probability; maintaining the domiciliation agreement, gérant decision minutes, French accounting records, and VAT filings at the registered office materially mitigates inspection risk.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffier du Tribunal de commerce / INPI
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: INPI formalities regulation and Greffe fee schedule; market benchmark for routing searches at EUR 10-20 per identifier

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the constitution notice (Avis de constitution) in a legal announcement journal (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal d'annonces légales holding prefecture accreditation (e.g., Les Affiches Parisiennes)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Decree-regulated JAL tariffs; market rate EUR 250-450 for approximately six lines of notice

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing through the Guichet Unique and RCS registration fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce (service des formalités)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Décret n° 2020-106 du 7 février 2020 fee schedule; SARL incorporation tariff approx. EUR 80 plus EUR 20 supplementary formality charges

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial intervention: notarised power of attorney and verification of statutory declarations of the gérant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Tariff regulation for notarial acts (Art. A. 444-3 Code de commerce); standard range EUR 400-700 per client file

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Virtual office and official domiciliation contract - first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Domiciliation provider approved by the Préfecture (agrément under Art. L.123-11-2 CCom)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark EUR 40-60 per month for a full registered-office package including mail handling, sign display, and RCS/BODACC correspondence

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn translations of UBO passports, proof of address, and birth certificates into French

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Free-market tariff, typically EUR 40-80 per page; estimated four pages for the full UBO/gérant bundle

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of the document set (five documents on average)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: High Court Apostille Registry (Hong Kong) or French Consulate in the document's country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille per-document fee approx. EUR 60 in HK (HK$125 court fee) plus courier; French consular legalization EUR 100-200 per document for non-Apostille jurisdictions

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/UBO/PEP and sanctions screening final compliance report by an independent compliance bureau
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Independent registered AML consultancy or law firm compliance desk
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Professional fee benchmark EUR 200-350 per entity; includes ofac/un/EU/France list re-screening at T-30 days before incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal counsel for drafting the SARL Articles of Association, governance annexes, and webtoon licensing/royalty IP clauses
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate EUR 220-380 per hour blended; estimated 6-8 hours for a multilingual webtoon publishing structure with ISIC 9000 scope

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10 (formation of commercial companies) and L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL-specific provisions), as amended by the Loi PACTE (Law No. 2019-486).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés) with jurisdiction over the registered office, via the Centre de Formalités des Entreprises / Guichet Unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts constitutifs (Articles of Association) and the M0 registration form (Déclaration de création d'entreprise) filed electronically on formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum share capital (Article L.223-2). Capital may be set freely, typically EUR 1.00. At least 20% of cash subscriptions must be paid up on incorporation, with the balance payable within five years (Article L.223-7). No statutory escrow account is required; cash contributions are deposited with a bank or notary, and in-kind contributions require a statutory auditor's report.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: At the constitutive general meeting of [COMPANY NAME], a French société à responsabilité limitée, duly held on [DATE], the shareholders unanimously resolved as follows: (1) The draft articles of association are approved, and the share subscriptions comprised therein are hereby ratified and accepted. (2) The registered office is fixed at [ADDRESS], in the city of Paris. (3) [NAME] is appointed as gérant (manager) of the company, with authority to represent the company and sign alone, subject to the articles and applicable law. (4) The gérant is instructed to complete all incorporation formalities, including publication, registration, and filings with the RCS. All acts accomplished prior to this meeting are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Authenticate the Articles of Association; Deposit Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the articles of association in French. The articles must state the corporate purpose (digital webtoon publishing, syndication, and multilingual chapter unlocking), corporate name, share capital, registered office, and management rules. If an authentic deed is used, obtain a notarized act. For cash contributions, deposit the funds with a bank or notary to obtain a capital-deposit certificate (attestation de dépôt de fonds).
required_dossiers: Draft articles of association (statuts en projet)
Attestation de dépôt de fonds (capital deposit certificate)
Bank or notary receipt for paid-up capital
Copy of registered-office lease or domiciliation agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the capital deposit is refused or incomplete, correct the contribution details and re-submit. If the articles are queried, amend the corporate purpose clause and re-file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publish the Mandatory Legal Notice (Annonce Légale)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a legal notice to an approved JAL. The notice must include the company name, legal form, capital amount, registered office, corporate purpose, duration, and the manager(s). The JAL issues an attestation of publication (attestation de parution).
required_dossiers: Draft legal notice
Copy of draft articles
Capital deposit certificate (if requested by the JAL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the announcement is inaccurate or incomplete, submit a corrective publication immediately and obtain a revised attestation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit the Incorporation File to the Guichet Unique (CFE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique – formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Centre de Formalités des Entreprises)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the electronic M0 form and upload all statutory documents, including the articles, publication attestation, capital certificate, identity and authorization documents, and the lease. Pay the applicable filing fee online. The system routes the file to the relevant RCS registry.
required_dossiers: M0 registration form
Signed articles of association
Attestation de parution (JAL)
Attestation de dépôt de fonds
Copy of registered-office lease
Identity documents of shareholders and manager(s)
Declaration of non-conviction for the manager
Power of attorney, if a representative signs the file
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the file is incomplete, the Guichet Unique issues a written request to supply missing information, which must be remedied within 30 days. Failure to respond results in automatic rejection; refiling is permitted without additional penalty if done within that period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (or Tribunal Judiciaire) with jurisdiction over the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After validation by the CFE, the registry updates the RCS, issues the SIREN number, and delivers the K-bis extract. The company acquires legal personality on the date of registration. Verify the K-bis data and request a QR-coded electronic copy for banking and tax purposes.
required_dossiers: Dossier transferred from the CFE
Proof of payment of the droit de greffe (filing fee)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries the legal form or capital, correct the statutory documents and re-register through the Guichet Unique. If the K-bis contains a typographical error, request a correction from the greffe under Article R.123-167 of the Code de commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt the First Board Resolutions and Executive Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Meeting of Shareholders (Assemblée Générale Ordinaire)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the constitutive general meeting at the registered office or remotely to approve the articles, ratify subscription commitments, fix the registered office, and appoint the gérant. Execute the minutes (procès-verbal) in the corporate minute book. The minutes are signed by all founders or proxy holders. The gérant accepts via a signed letter.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the constitutive general meeting (procès-verbal d'assemblée générale constitutive)
Letter of acceptance from the gérant
Declaration of no criminal conviction (extrait de casier judiciaire n°3)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: No procedural adverse action is expected. If a shareholder challenges the adoption, reconvene the meeting and record the correction before filing the minutes with the registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete Post-Registration Tax, Social and Beneficial-Owner Declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE (SIRENE), URSSAF (social security), DGFiP (tax), and RCS beneficial-owner register
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: RCS registration automatically triggers INSEE attribution of a SIRET. Independently, file the Declaration of Beneficial Owners (Déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs) with the greffe or through the Guichet Unique, and register with URSSAF for social contributions. If applicable, request a VAT EU number. Verify the tax code and corporate income tax election (IS/IR) as stated in the articles.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract
Beneficial-owner declaration form and identity documents of natural persons owning more than 25%
Consent of managers to joint liability (if required)
URSSAF registration form (if not pre-filled)
Tax form for IS/IR election, if any special election is made
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the beneficial-owner declaration is incomplete, the registrar issues a formal demand with penalty warning. Submit the supplemental information within 15 days to avoid the administrative fine.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No competent industrial authority is required for digital webtoon syndication. If physical printing or warehousing were introduced, the Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) would administer any installation-classification permit; cultural media matters are overseen by the Direction Générale des Médias et des Industries Culturelles (DGMIC), Ministry of Culture.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required – digital webtoon publishing is a non-regulated service. An optional legal-deposit receipt from the Bibliothèque nationale de France (BnF) is recommended for digital publications under Article L.133-1 of the Code du patrimoine, but it is not an operating license.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) – Inspection des Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no installation classifiable under the ICPE nomenclature for a digital studio or office. No environmental authorization is required. If warehousing or printing is later introduced, reassess under the ICPE regime with a preliminary notification.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable at this stage. The activity must comply with general municipal waste management rules under the Code de l'environnement for office waste. If a print shop or warehouse is added, the applicable thresholds for volatile organic compounds under the IED and the classification of warehouses (rubric 1510) would apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Workplace safety clearance: obtain a fire safety certificate from the competent commission de sécurité for the premises, in accordance with Code du travail Articles R.4227-1 to R.4227-21. For registered office use, conduct a structural load inspection if server equipment is installed, and register a medical and occupational health unit with the Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail (SPST) of the regional CARSAT.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques (DGFiP), through the relevant Service des impôts des entreprises (SIE) and the Service des impôts des entreprises étrangères (SIEE) for non-established businesses. Online administration is principally provided through impots.gouv.fr; company formation and business-registration filings are submitted through the Guichet unique operated by the Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A French SARL is registered through the INPI Guichet unique. The filing generates a SIREN identifier for the legal entity and a SIRET identifier for each establishment, with registration recorded in the Registre national des entreprises. The company then activates its professional tax account on impots.gouv.fr and identifies its competent SIE. A French VAT number is issued by the DGFiP in the format FR followed by a two-character control key and the nine-digit SIREN. The VAT registration request normally requires the Kbis or registration certificate, articles of association, identification of managers and beneficial owners, registered office evidence, business description, projected taxable turnover, bank details, and evidence of economic activity. A foreign entity without a French establishment applies to the SIEE for a French VAT number where required and appoints a French tax representative only where legally required, including applicable cases involving non-EU businesses. EU-established businesses generally do not require a French fiscal representative but remain responsible for registration, filings, invoicing, and payment obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A SARL is generally subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés, IS). A qualifying SARL may elect temporary taxation under personal income tax (impôt sur le revenu, IR) for up to five fiscal years, subject to statutory conditions concerning age, ownership, workforce, turnover, and activity. A qualifying family SARL may elect IR taxation without the ordinary five-year limitation, provided all statutory family-ownership and consent conditions remain satisfied. The election must be made within the applicable statutory period and notified to the DGFiP. France has no general United States-style check-the-box election. Anti-hybrid mismatch rules apply mandatorily and do not create an elective hybrid classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT), administered under the French VAT regime and harmonized EU VAT rules.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For an established French business using the VAT exemption for small enterprises, the principal services turnover threshold is EUR 37,500, with a higher tolerance threshold of EUR 41,250; goods and certain accommodation and catering activities generally use thresholds of EUR 85,000 and EUR 93,500. These thresholds concern eligibility for the French small-business VAT exemption rather than a universal exemption from registration. A business making taxable transactions outside the exemption, or a non-established business required to account for French VAT, may need registration regardless of turnover. Digital services supplied business-to-consumer to EU customers are subject to EU place-of-supply rules and may be reported through the One Stop Shop (OSS), while business-to-business services generally follow the customer-location reverse-charge rules.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France does not currently operate a universal real-time invoice-clearance system for ordinary domestic transactions. Mandatory domestic B2B e-invoicing is being phased in through approved private electronic invoicing platforms: all businesses must be able to receive electronic invoices from 1 September 2026; large and mid-sized businesses must issue them from that date; small and micro-enterprises must issue them from 1 September 2027, subject to legislative or regulatory amendments. Electronic transaction reporting for transactions outside the domestic B2B e-invoicing perimeter is introduced on the same phased timetable. Public-sector invoices are submitted through Chorus Pro. Invoices must satisfy French VAT content, authenticity, integrity, legibility, retention, and audit-trail requirements; no general digital tax stamp is presently required for ordinary VAT invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from France to destinations outside the EU may be invoiced without French VAT if the supplier can prove that the goods left the EU customs territory and satisfy the statutory export conditions. The supplier must retain a customs export declaration and transport or delivery evidence linking the goods to the export transaction. Supplies to customers in another EU Member State are generally intra-Community supplies rather than exports and require the applicable customer VAT-number, transport, and recapitulative-statement conditions. Webtoon licensing, digital content, and electronic services require separate place-of-supply analysis: B2B supplies to an established business outside France are generally outside French VAT under the customer-location rule, while B2C electronic services are subject to EU consumer-location rules and may require OSS or local registration. An offshore service is not automatically a zero-rated French export merely because payment is received from abroad.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic export declaration filed through the applicable French customs system, including the Movement Reference Number (MRN)
Export accompanying document or equivalent customs evidence showing release for export and exit from the EU customs territory
Commercial invoice identifying the supplier, customer, goods, value, contractual terms, and VAT treatment
Bill of lading, airway bill, carrier evidence, or other transport documentation demonstrating shipment outside the EU
Proof of exit generated or validated by customs, where available
Purchase order, contract, delivery records, and accounting evidence linking the export declaration to the invoice
Customer VAT identification evidence and transport proof for intra-Community supplies, where the transaction is an EU dispatch rather than an export
Bank payment evidence where relevant; a French inward remittance certificate is not generally a statutory prerequisite for export VAT exemption
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: France has no general foreign-exchange control rule requiring export proceeds to be repatriated within 180 days. Export VAT exemption depends on objective proof of export and correct transaction classification, not on a statutory repatriation deadline. If the DGFiP determines that zero-rating was unsupported, it may assess the unpaid VAT retrospectively, together with late-payment interest generally calculated at 0.20% per month, subject to statutory rules and applicable periods. A 40% surcharge may apply for deliberate failure or deliberate misapplication, and an 80% surcharge may apply in cases involving fraudulent manoeuvres or abuse of rights; higher consequences may apply for concealed or fictitious transactions. Customs violations may generate separate customs duties, VAT assessments, administrative penalties, seizure, and criminal exposure. Input-VAT refunds may be denied or clawed back where export evidence is incomplete, inconsistent, fabricated, or not retained. Tax and customs records should be retained for the applicable statutory period, commonly six years for tax audit purposes and longer where accounting or customs rules require it.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Central Bank of France) and the French Treasury (Direction Générale du Trésor) for foreign exchange regulations and cross-border capital movement reporting.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France, as a Eurozone member, maintains full convertibility for both current and capital account transactions under EU law. Profit remittance is unrestricted, subject to standard tax reporting and anti-money laundering compliance. No exchange control approvals are required for ordinary business transactions, but cross-border capital movements exceeding €15,000 per transaction must be reported to the Banque de France for statistical and balance-of-payments purposes.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no mandatory surrender of export proceeds in France. Exporters may retain foreign currency in designated accounts. However, all cross-border transactions (including export receipts) exceeding €15,000 must be reported to the Banque de France via the appropriate electronic declaration (CERFA form or direct reporting). No conversion ratio is imposed; companies may freely convert EUR to foreign currency or hold foreign currency balances.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for EU-licensed Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) such as Qonto, Shine, or Lydia for operational accounts, given their streamlined onboarding and digital-first approach. However, for cross-border payments and multi-currency treasury operations, these EMIs may have limitations in terms of FX hedging and large-volume international wire transfers. Offshore digital EMIs (non-EU) are generally not viable due to regulatory restrictions under PSD2 and French banking law; they would require a branch or subsidiary in France to operate legally.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Most traditional tier-1 banks require the legal representative (gérant) of the SARL to appear physically at a branch for initial onboarding and KYC verification. Some banks (e.g., BNP Paribas, Société Générale) offer remote video verification for corporate accounts, but this is not universal and often subject to additional due diligence. For a SARL with non-resident shareholders, physical presence of the gérant is strongly recommended to expedite the process. Remote opening is possible with select fintech banks, but may involve stricter documentary requirements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High volume of micro-transactions from in-app purchases (Apple IAP, Google Play Billing) potentially flagged as unusual activity or potential money laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide platform contracts with Apple and Google, detailed revenue reports from the app stores, a clear business model description (digital webtoon publishing), and a breakdown of transaction flows. Include audited financial statements or provisional accounts, and a compliance policy for handling refunds and chargebacks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border payments to content creators and licensors in multiple jurisdictions, raising concerns about sanctions or terrorist financing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintain a comprehensive list of all counterparties with full legal names, addresses, and tax identification numbers. Provide contracts and licensing agreements, and implement a robust sanctions screening process. Submit a written AML/CFT policy, proof of beneficial ownership, and a description of the payment flow (e.g., via SWIFT MT103).

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For capital injections from non-resident shareholders, use SWIFT MT103 wire transfers with a clear purpose code (e.g., 'Capital Contribution' or 'Direct Investment'). The transfer must be reported to the Banque de France if the amount exceeds €15,000. The SARL must provide a copy of the share subscription agreement and proof of the shareholder's identity and source of funds. Funds should be routed to the SARL's operational account in EUR; conversion from foreign currency is permitted at market rates.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For trade settlements (e.g., royalty payments to content creators, licensing fees), use SWIFT MT103 for international transfers or SEPA Credit Transfer for EU-based counterparties. For larger or more complex transactions, a Commercial Letter of Credit (LC) may be used, though it is uncommon for digital services. All outbound payments must be supported by underlying contracts and comply with French tax withholding obligations (e.g., 25% withholding on royalties to non-residents, subject to treaty relief).
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for exotic currencies (e.g., KRW, JPY) if needed
Cross-Currency Swaps (for longer-term hedging of revenue streams)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Activity Confirmation (Confirmation annuelle d'activité) — revalidation of RCS/RNE registered data
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: INPI via the Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (single electronic portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each calendar year from 1 January to 15 April; first confirmation due in the calendar year following incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: RNE status flagged 'inactive'; Kbis extracts and registry certificates refused; after administrative reminders, the Public Prosecutor may seek court-ordered radiation (strike-off) from the RCS

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts deposit (Dépôt des comptes annuels) — balance sheet, profit and loss account, annex notes, management report, and auditor's report if applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) via the Guichet Unique / INPI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months of the fiscal year end; shareholder approval must occur within 6 months of the fiscal year end; for a 31 December year end, deposit due by 31 July; court-ordered extension of up to 6 months available
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court injunction proceeding; civil fine up to EUR 9,000 for the manager; two consecutive non-filings may trigger simplified judicial liquidation and administrative radiation from the RCS

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO declaration update (Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs — RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days of any change in beneficial ownership (more than 25% capital or voting rights or de facto control); no fixed annual date, but UBO data is re-attested annually through the January–April Activity Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to EUR 30,000 and up to 6 months imprisonment under Articles L. 561-46 and L. 561-53 of the Monetary and Financial Code; false declarations may trigger disqualification of managers; subsequent RCS filings may be blocked

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting (Assemblée Générale Ordinaire) — approval of prior-year accounts, discharge of management, appropriation of results
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate organ; minutes retained in the statutory Minute Book (no public filing unless the meeting resolves registered legal events)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the fiscal year end; the Commercial Court may extend the deadline upon reasoned request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Manager exposed to a civil fine up to EUR 9,000; shareholders may petition the Court to appoint a special agent (mandataire de justice) to convene the meeting; unconvened approval invalidates the subsequent accounts deposit

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) when two of three thresholds are exceeded for two consecutive financial years (for years opening on or after 1 January 2024): total balance sheet above EUR 4,000,000 (approx. USD 4,320,000); net turnover exclusive of VAT above EUR 8,000,000 (approx. USD 8,640,000); average workforce above 50 employees (Decret n. 2024-152). Audit is also compulsory when the SARL controls or is controlled by a group exceeding the combined thresholds, or upon court order following a shareholder request (Articles L. 232-5 and L. 612-1 of the Commercial Code).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP exclusively — ANC Regulation 2014-03 (Plan Comptable General); IFRS is not permitted for the individual statutory accounts of an unlisted SARL and may apply only to consolidated accounts of certain listed groups.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France imposes no standalone UBO annual form. The beneficial-owner declaration filed at incorporation must be updated with the Greffe within 15 days of any change concerning a natural person holding more than 25% of share capital or voting rights, exercising de facto control, or benefiting from statutory control powers. Each year from 1 January to 15 April the Activity Confirmation re-attests the UBO dataset stored in the RNE/RCS; the re-attestation itself is free of charge and does not require a new declaration when facts are unchanged. The share transfer register must reconcile with the RBE declaration so that the reference shareholders as of 31 December are accurately shown.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registre des mouvements de titres (Share Transfer and Part Cession Register)
Registre des decisions et deliberations (Minute Book of Shareholder Decisions)
Registre unique du personnel (Single Staff Register) — mandatory if any employee is on the French payroll

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 140–540 (EUR 130–500) per year for provincial commercial domiciliation; USD 540–1,080 (EUR 500–1,000) per year for Paris business-address domiciliation with mail handling and legal notice forwarding
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,250–13,000 (EUR 3,000–12,000) for a typical small-to-mid-size SARL; voluntary audit or contractual review for a micro-SARL from approximately USD 1,600 (EUR 1,500)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D tax credit (up to 30% of eligible expenses), innovation status benefits, apprenticeship tax credit

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Déclaration de résultat (corporate tax return form, filed electronically via impots.gouv.fr portal)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after fiscal year-end (for calendar-year SARL companies, by 15 May of the following year)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Base taxable profit before adjustments and deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents restricted to French-source income adjustments only

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Eligible deductions, exemptions, and tax credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Limited to permanent establishment income for non-residents

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax computation and payment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Withholding tax credits applied where applicable

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 0.5% per month of tax due, capped at 25%, plus interest charges and potential criminal sanctions

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit TRC (Treaty Relief Certificate) to tax authorities prior to dividend distribution to claim reduced or zero withholding tax under applicable DTAs
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 10% statutory rate, reduced to 0-5% under most treaties; Interest: 0% under EU Interest and Royalties Directive, 10% otherwise

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: 50 million euros (annual turnover threshold triggering Local File and Master File requirements)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France enforces Economic Substance Regulations for preferential tax regimes and substance requirements under DAC6; absence of economic substance may result in denial of tax benefits and transfer pricing adjustments

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission or understatement of taxable income in corporate tax return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties including up to 5 years imprisonment and fines up to 80% of the evaded tax amount
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, possible imprisonment, and obligation to repay evaded taxes plus interest

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing or maintaining a shell entity without genuine business operations or economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax penalties up to 80% of the tax evaded, plus potential criminal prosecution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil leading to personal restitution orders, fines, and imprisonment

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to perform adequate KYC, CDD, or suspicious transaction reporting in cross-border digital syndication payments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to 1.5 million euros or 10% of annual turnover, plus criminal sanctions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines, disqualification from management roles, and potential jail time for willful non-compliance
